item.summary: Union Minister for Finance and Corporate Affairs, Smt. Nirmala Sitharaman chaired a series of pre-budget consultation meetings for the preparation of the Union Budget 2027-28 between 16 and 26 November 2026 .
item.title: Union Minister of Finance & Corporate Affairs Smt. Nirmala Sitharaman concludes extensive pre-budget consultations for Union Budget 2027-28
